description.value:
The contract exists to serve the people bound by it.

Mode: Care through obligation / drift: Away

Level 1: The Protected Clause

Your default Leverage expenditure is Invocation of Protection — you identify a clause in an agreement, law, or institutional policy that protects a vulnerable party (a tenant, a prisoner, a refugee, a conscripted soldier, a debtor). You invoke the protection on that party's behalf, and the relevant authority must honor the clause or be in formal violation. Costs [TBD:balance — 2 Leverage]. Vulnerable parties don't need to know you're helping them; the Steward often works anonymously.

Level 5: Standing Writ

You may issue a Standing Writ on behalf of a single named individual or small group (up to [TBD:balance — 5] people). The Writ grants them: reroll the lowest die on checks against forced compliance (slavery, conscription, compelled contract signing), automatic success on checks to invoke their rights in formal proceedings, and a [TBD:balance — 1 hour] detection when those rights are violated. Costs [TBD:balance — 4 Leverage]. Duration: until revoked or the Steward dies.

Level 9: The Community Precedent

When you invoke a clause for the protection of a group of [TBD:balance — 10+] people, the invocation gains community weight — the authority compelled to honor it suffers Morale OP penalties if they attempt to resist, and the protected community gains a [TBD:balance — stability bonus] to their hex's resilience for [TBD:balance — a week].

Level 13: Sanctuary

Once per session, you may declare a location a Sanctuary — a hex, building, or specific area where Stewardship-protected parties are protected from forcible removal, conscription, arrest under unjust law, or magical compulsion to leave. The Sanctuary's protection is binding on all parties who have any formal standing in the setting. Creatures outside formal standing (bandits, monsters, extra-dimensional hostiles) are unaffected and must be dealt with directly. Duration: [TBD:balance — 1 week or until formally contested].

Level 17: The Living Body (Capstone)

You may declare a Living Body — a set of humane obligations that become binding on a faction, hex, or community of your choice that you have meaningfully served. The Body consists of [TBD:balance — 5] protections you specify: rights of the governed, limits on authority, conditions of succession. The Body becomes formally binding, enforceable by any Pactkeeper who invokes it, and gradually shifts the target's Political Drift toward Egalitarian / Democratic regardless of starting position.
